static gboolean root_propertied (  GdkXEvent *  x,
GdkEventProperty *  ev,
gpointer  data
)  [static]
 

listen for properites on the root-window changing.

for now, we're only interested in the rootmap ("wallpaper") changing, because we need to update our transparency pixmap when that happens. this will cycle through all windows we have as we don't get this event on a per-window basis. (event-filter)

Parameters:
x - the X-event, or NULL
ev - the property event
data - NULL

static int window_trans_update (  noir_sess *  ns  )  [inline, static]
 

update all transparency pixmaps in a window.

for now, this will be zero or more of icon-view and shelf, ie whatever is present and uses evas. evas_bg_update() will call bg_upd() if present in the background plug-in; the plug-in may update the background in whatever manner it sees fit. if it supports pseudo-transparency, it may call transparency_get_pixmap() in evas2.c to obtain a suitable pixmap.

Parameters:
ns - the session
